content.short: CSWAP DEX is a Cardano decentralized exchange combining token swaps, NFTfi ideas, and wallet access.
content.description: CSWAP DEX is a Cardano decentralized exchange project built around community-driven DeFi and Plutus smart contracts. The platform aims to support token swaps, liquidity activity, and NFTfi-related opportunities while keeping the experience accessible across major Cardano wallets such as Yoroi, Nami, Eternl, Flint, and GeroWallet. Its positioning is a progressive DEX for the Cardano ecosystem, combining trading infrastructure with new financial use cases for native assets, NFTs, and liquidity providers.
